company_identity.legal_name: 中远海运控股股份有限公司

forecast_handoff.accounting_basis: Attributable net profit; FY2026-FY2028 are analyst-range-informed scenario assumptions, not company guidance.

scenario_assumptions.base: Uses the current post-H1 broker range and assumes a roughly 50% ordinary cash payout; demand growth remains modest while the fleet-delivery overhang prevents a return to pandemic margins.
scenario_assumptions.bear: Assumes freight-rate normalization, delivery pressure and weaker demand; it is a stress path, not a broker consensus. It remains positive in the forecast only because the historical 2016 loss already supplies the lower-tail economic evidence.
scenario_assumptions.capital: Forecast ROE uses a mechanical equity path from 2025 ending equity plus scenario profit less a 50% payout. It must be refreshed after FY2026 results.

valuation_handoff.accounting_basis: TTM attributable profit = FY2025 - H1FY2025 + H1FY2026; ROE uses the disclosed FY2025 and 2026H1 ending equity two-point average.
valuation_handoff.execution_pr_basis: Current weak run-rate path: PE_TTM/ROE_TTM = 0.805; same-date PB cross-check is about 0.803. The small difference is two-point average equity and display rounding. This deliberately conservative path, not the neutral normalized path, is the only PR used for conditional price mapping.
valuation_handoff.cycle_anchor_note: Complete-cycle phase-balanced neutral ROE is usable as a diagnostic, but the 10-year lower-tail blended bear ROE is negative. A PB/ROE-squared bear PR would have no economic meaning; therefore it cannot be used to unlock a position.

dupont_ttm.change_vs_fy2025: The TTM ROE decline is mainly margin-led: net margin about 12.03% versus FY2025 about 14.06%; turnover is slightly better and leverage is broadly stable.

price_bands.basis: Conditional map from execution_PR=decision_PR=0.805 and price CNY16.19. Price alone never unlocks a tier while cycle_anchor_conflict is insufficient.

exit_handoff.historical_anchor_note: No S/H/M threshold is emitted. The required adjusted monthly peak series and peak-date public financial inputs were not retrievable in this run; current financials are not backfilled into history.
exit_handoff.reprice_trigger: new periodic report, profit warning, CCFI/freight-rate regime change, material fleet-delivery update, dividend/share-count change, or an 8% price move

peer_timing.note: Peer 20-day returns were not reported because the public day-line endpoint was unavailable; this does not change the independent mixed industry-supply conclusion.

position_handoff.portfolio_constraints: unverified: portfolio value, existing shipping exposure, correlation and chosen risk budget were not provided.

invalidation_triggers: FY2026 results or a profit warning
two comparable reports with volume/revenue weakness plus further shipping-margin compression
CCFI/freight rates, orderbook deliveries or effective capacity materially deviate from the stated mixed-cycle case
audit qualification, material governance event, debt/cash deterioration or ordinary payout change
price moves 8 percent from 2026-09-11 or crosses a conditional execution-PR boundary
